_comment: Sloshing via timed events: shallow 0.3 m lake; at t=1.0 s the tank tilts to 0.28 rad, at t=2.5 s it releases back to level, exciting a sloshing mode. End-wall probes are wave gauges - plot probe0_h/probe1_h from --stats to see the oscillation and its decay. First sloshing natural frequency for L=2.22, h=0.3: f = sqrt(g k tanh(k h)) / 2pi with k = pi/L, about 0.375 Hz (period ~2.7 s).
